messages:
Maya: Heads-up: late-binding config apply is causing surprises for ops during canaries. Example: console shows `applied` but runtime still using old snapshot.
Tom: Seen that. Happens when operator applies with dry_run=false but previewing on staging. Likely race between snapshot rehydrate and router reload.
Maya: Agree. We should block apply until snapshot rehydrate ack? @Harry any telemetry we can use to detect in-flight rehydrate?
Harry: We have `config_rehydrate_duration_ms` metric per region and a `snapshot_version_in_use` gauge. Can correlate to detect nodes lagging.
Sarah: UX idea: Console shows two states — 'Queued for activation' and 'Active on X% cohorts'. Prevent showing 'Applied' until active on at least one node.
Jen: Ops concern: blocking apply extends deploys. Maybe add `apply_mode` with `late_bind: true|false`. Default true keeps current behavior; false attempts immediate activation and surfaces risk.
Tom: Implementation thought: API `POST /configs/{id}/apply?late_bind=false` returns 202 with `activation_window_id`. Client can poll `/activation_windows/{id}/progress` or subscribe to a stream.
Maya: Also need quota implications. When a config increases route weight to a more expensive model, we must ensure quota reservation is computed and approved before activation.
Sarah: Telemetry: surface `activation_impact_estimate` in console (tokens/s, cost delta). We could run a simulated dry-run in a cheap sandbox to estimate.
ops-bot: deploy-checklist: ensure `config_rehydrate_duration_ms` < 60s for target region; activation_progress >= 1% within 10m or auto-rollback.
Tom: Edge case: Dedicated customers may want to force immediate activation even if some nodes are behind. Allow `force_activate=true` but require enterprise role check.
Harry: Add to rollout telemetry: sample 1% of request traces tagged with `activation_window_id` and `pre/post` to catch regressions quickly.
Maya: OK action items: 1) API param `late_bind` + role-gated `force_activate` 2) Console state/guardrails and explainer 3) Telemetry: rehydrate metric, activation_progress, sampled traces 4) Quota precompute API call. I'll draft RFC and a playbook.
Sarah: +1. Also include a tiny tooltip in console: 'Why activation can be delayed' linking to runbook :book:.
Jen: Ops will run the dry-run and validate metrics on next window. :thumbsup:
Maya: Filing RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/1751239876-late-bind-rollout
ops-bot: Note: scheduled dry-run 2025-03-11 20:00 UTC.
